# GoogleWorkspace

Google Workspace includes Google Meet video conferencing and more cloud-based productivity and collaboration tools.

Scroll to bottom of the hero section

![People in huddle room using Google Meet](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B2B-LIFE-Enhanced-Productivity-03-Google-scaled.jpg)

### AVI-SPL is a Google Meet Partner Level Partner

Our experienced team is ready to help you migrate to Google Workspace or integrate it with your current collaboration systems. When you work with AVI-SPL, we:

- **Deliver value** – improve your team productivity and efficiency and measure the benefits with [actionable data insights](https://avispl.com/symphony/)
- **Enhance user experience** – ensure secure, seamless, and a positive user experience
- **Ease IT operations** – manage the planning, implementation, and support of your Zoom solutions to achieve your goals

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/google/#contact)

![People in huddle room using Google Meet](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/B2B-LIFE-Enhanced-Productivity-01-Google-2-scaled.jpg)

### Set up Your Teams for Success with Google

Google Workspace offers meetings, chat, calendars, conference rooms, email, and team productivity solutions.

- Google Meet: keep teams connected with secure video meetings
- Calendar: shareable calendars that integrate with Gmail, Drive, Meet, and other Google tools
- Productivity software: chat, email, Docs, and more
- Security and management: Centralized admin control, endpoint management for data security, Vault for data retention
- Work Insights: easily track usage and adoption

![Man and woman with glasses sit at table, smiling. Sunlit room. Hes in green jacket, shes in white shirt.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/google-workspace-img.png)

### Google Services by AVI-SPL

AVI-SPL globally delivers and supports Google Workspace solutions to connect on-site and remote workers. Our team includes certified specialists in [design](https://avispl.com/services/design-planning/), integration, regional and global implementations, and [24/7 support](https://avispl.com/services/support-and-maintenance/).

[Contact Us](https://avispl.com/google/#contact)

[![screen showing man on video call](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/thumbnail-14.31.04-1.jpg)](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/NGPyOHKWLFQ)

### Book a Google Beam Demo

Google partnerd with with HP on breakthrough technology that makes remote conversations feel like you’re in the same room without the need for additional glasses or headsets. See it live! AVI-SPL can schedule demo at a Google location!

- Google is working to enable Beam directly from the video conferencing services you use today — such as Google Meet and Zoom.
- Google Beam achieves this sense of presence using advancements in AI, 3D imaging, and other technologies.
- The light field display creates a sense of volume and depth, delivering an immersive communication experience unlike anything you’ve seen before.

[Contact Us to book a demo](https://avispl.com/contact-us/)

##### AI-powered    video conferencing

Gemini in Meet handles note taking, translates conversations in real-time, and fixes poor video/audio, so you can focus on the conversation.

##### Full participation    in hybrid meetings

Easily collaborate with teams of any size, from any device – at home, the office, and anywhere in between.

##### Security and    data protections

Ensure safe meetings with advanced host controls, anti-abuse measures, and encryption by default.

##### Enterprise-ready

Moving to Meet for enterprise-grade video conferencing can save subscription costs and streamline management in the Workspace Admin console.

##### Collaboration    Tools

Bring third-party tools into your meeting, such as whiteboarding apps from Figma, LucidSpark, Miro, and more.

##### Meet-Certified Devices

The Meet-Certified Device portfolio includes room kits and all-in-one collaboration devices to easily and quickly set up personal and team spaces.

## Howcan  wehelp?

Discover how our Google experts can transform your hybrid workplace with a single solution. We’ll help you design solutions that enhance productivity and support your employee experience goals.  We offer:

[Contact](https://avispl.com/google/#contact)

- ###### Comprehensive collaboration   solutions at your fingertips




Explore how Google Workspace helps you create a productive hybrid workplace for your distributed teams. Our certified specialists provide [design](https://avispl.com/services/design-planning/), integration, and regional and global deployments.

- ###### Strategic business and    technology alignment




The team’s subject matter experts can advise and guide you through seeding and proof-of-value programs that align with your business needs. The practice offers strategic roadmap services to establish the link from what’s possible to real business outcomes.

- ###### Tailored adoption and    support services




The first part of your journey is crucial. Let AVI-SPL help you define your business outcomes and plan your implementation, engage your user community, maximize business value, and track success.


### Videos

[![Text image that says Google Cloud at Work Google and Gemini](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/thumbnail-14.31.40.jpg)](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CFp5jLqmhzc)

[![Google meet icons with text the best of Google AI is now available in Google Workspace](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/thumbnail-14.33.14.jpg)](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VOcSrLykC4E)
